title: Turning See Financial Data on shows a confirmation dialog
custom_preconds: 1. You are editing a custom role and See Financial Data is currently OFF.
custom_steps:
1. Scroll to the Cross-Cutting Toggles card.
  2. Turn the See Financial Data toggle ON.
  3. Look at the dialog.
  4. Read its title and buttons.
custom_expected: A dialog titled 'Enable See Financial Data?' appears with Cancel and Enable buttons.
evidence: 'Enable See Financial Data?' + Cancel/Enable confirmed in build (FinancialDataConfirmModal).
